metadata.title: FinPlan — personal finance toolkit
metadata.description: A local-first collection of interactive planners for debt, budgets, retirement, taxes and everyday money decisions.

footer.localNote: Everything runs and stays in your browser. No accounts, no tracking — your data never leaves this device.
footer.disclaimer: An independent educational project. Not financial advice.

hub.heroTitle: Make sense of your money, one plan at a time.
hub.heroSubtitle: A toolkit of hands-on planners for debt, budgeting, investing and everyday spending — all running privately in your browser.
hub.statsPrivateLabel: Private by design — data stays on your device

planning.name: Goals & planning
planning.blurb: Map where you are headed and check how ready you are.

budgeting.name: Budgeting
budgeting.blurb: Give every unit of income a job and watch it behave.

debt.name: Debt & loans
debt.blurb: See exactly what borrowing costs — and how to escape it faster.

investing.name: Investing
investing.blurb: Compare strategies and keep fees from eating your returns.

protection.name: Taxes & protection
protection.blurb: Cover the risks and keep more of what you earn.

debt.title: Debt payoff planner
debt.description: Compare snowball, avalanche and hybrid payoff plans month by month.

budget.title: Yearly budget
budget.description: Plan twelve months of income and spending by category.

retirement.title: Retirement planner
retirement.description: Project growth, test scenarios and find your FIRE number.

jar.title: Six jars manager
jar.description: Split income across jars and track each balance over time.

loan.title: Loan explainer
loan.description: Watch principal and interest split apart over a loan's lifetime.

tax.title: Tax planner
tax.description: Apply bracket tables, deductions and preview take-home pay.

timeline.title: Life goals timeline
timeline.description: Put house, kids and retirement on one shared timeline.

pay.title: Subscriptions tracker
pay.description: Keep tabs on recurring payments and renewal dates.

dca.title: DCA fee comparator
dca.description: See how fund fees compound against long-term investing.

flow.title: Cash flow planner
flow.description: Visualize monthly income versus expenses and stress-test changes.

credit-card.title: Credit card compare
credit-card.description: Rank cards by fees and rewards for your spending profile.

travel-card.title: Travel card comparator
travel-card.description: Compare FX fees and rewards for spending abroad.

insurance.title: Insurance manager
insurance.description: Summarize policies and spot coverage gaps per family member.

strategy.title: Investment strategy board
strategy.description: Collect thesis, scenarios and risks on one board.

kingdom.title: Budget kingdom
kingdom.description: Turn categories into buildings and grow them toward goals.

wake-up.title: Readiness quiz
wake-up.description: Score your financial foundations with a ten-question checklist.

portfolio-analyzer.title: Portfolio analyzer
portfolio-analyzer.description: Paste your holdings to reveal allocation and concentration.

statement.title: Statement parser
statement.description: Import CSV statements and auto-categorize transactions.
